# GAMbit Release Notes

This release strengthens security, improves Undo accuracy, and adds safeguards for shared workflows, scheduled jobs, and year-end rollover.

## Important upgrade actions

- **Review and sign existing shared items:** Older items will not run in the background until reviewed and signed in **Settings → Team → Signatures & trust…**.
- **Renew pending approvals:** Pending two-person requests require approval again. Email approvals require new request emails.
- **Enable Gmail access for email approvals:** The service account needs Gmail read access to approvers’ mailboxes.
- **Update help-desk PINs:** PINs must now contain at least 6 characters.
- **Back up the Builder release key:** Keep a secure backup of `%APPDATA%\GAMbit Builder\release-signing.key`. If lost, existing installations will require a manual update before trusting releases signed with a new key.

## Security improvements

- **Signed shared workflows:** Shared Run later items, offboarding plans, time-limited accounts, policy plans, automatic groups, requests, approvals, approval rules, and workflow settings now require digital signatures. Background tasks skip unsigned or modified items, as well as actions outside the signer’s role or permitted org units.
- **Approval integrity:** Approvals apply to the exact commands reviewed. Changes require fresh approval, users cannot approve their own two-person requests, and email approvals are accepted only from the approver’s own Sent mail.
- **Safer password handling:** Passwords cannot be queued for later. Requests use a `{new-password}` placeholder populated at execution. Passwords are removed from completed queue items and approval requests, and commands with removed passwords cannot run.
- **Offboarding password protection:** Lock passwords are generated only when GAM runs and are never saved. Older saved plans are cleaned when first opened.
- **Encrypted secrets:** Tokens, including the Builder’s GitHub token, are now encrypted. Backups containing secrets require a password.
- **Clipboard protection:** Copied passwords are excluded from clipboard history and cleared after 60 seconds.
- **Verified updates:** GAMbit, GAM, and local AI model updates are checked against a hash. GAMbit releases also require the Builder’s signature. Shared deployment files must be signed by an administrator or protected against changes by non-administrators.
- **Scheduled script fixes:** Fixed command-injection issues involving special characters in scheduled job names and webhook alerts.
- **Additional safeguards:** Help-desk restrictions now recognize wrapped commands, the AI assistant is limited to plain lookup commands, and spreadsheet exports prevent formula injection.
- **Computer-wide sign-in enforcement:** Added an option to require sign-in for everyone using GAMbit on a computer.

## Reliability and workflow improvements

- **Stricter Practice mode:** Live changes run only when every affected target is the test account or within the test org unit. Group changes, adding or moving objects into org units, and commands referencing additional people—such as Drive transfers, delegation, or forwarding—remain dry runs.
- **Accurate Undo:** Before changing suspension, password-change requirements, directory visibility, or archive status, GAMbit reads the current values. Undo restores only accounts that actually changed, including changes across an entire org unit. Undo is unavailable when the original value is unknown and cannot run under a different domain profile.
- **Safer year-end rollover:** Grades pair numerically, such as 9 → 10. Skipped-grade mappings and circular moves are rejected, moves run from the highest grade down, and any failed move stops the rollover.
- **Graduation safeguards:** Graduation requires an alumni org unit. “Suspend graduates” can target only a graduates org unit, never a grade org unit.
- **Run later protection:** Queue items cannot execute twice across two PCs and always run under the domain profile in which they were queued.
- **Preserved Chromebook notes:** Check-out/in, lost-device, and senior-collection notes are added to existing notes instead of replacing them.
- **Safer roster sync:** Saving IDs or job titles requires a refreshed user list, preserving existing IDs and organization details. Test mode no longer emails real supervisors or adds test accounts to real groups.

## Other behavior changes

- With **Dry run** or **Practice mode** enabled, **Run here now** will not launch background tasks. Saved Chromebook jobs only preview their changes.
- In **Manage user**, a name must match exactly one person. Ambiguous matches require a full email address.
